description: This file defines a scheduled job system for Mattermost plugins, including job scheduling, metadata management, and execution control.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job with execution control, metadata, and callback.

classes.name: JobMetadata
classes.description: Stores metadata about the last execution time of a job.

classes.name: JobConfig
classes.description: Configuration for a scheduled job, primarily the interval.

classes.name: JobPluginAPI
classes.description: Interface for plugin API interactions required for job scheduling and storage.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Creates and starts a new scheduled job.

methods.name: readMetadata
methods.description: Reads job metadata from key-value store.

methods.name: saveMetadata
methods.description: Saves job metadata to key-value store.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main loop for executing the scheduled job at appropriate intervals.

methods.name: MakeWaitForInterval
methods.description: Creates a wait interval function based on fixed interval.

methods.name: MakeWaitForRoundedInterval
methods.description: Creates a wait interval function that rounds to the nearest interval.
